verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no probe or documentation of a robots.txt on handelsregister.de or unternehmensregister.de. The only crawler-related probe is for llms.txt, which returned 404 and is a different file, so it cannot be credited here. Publishing robots.txt is a fair axis for any public web service, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
